verdict.rationale: Retell's MCP/agent API explicitly supports listing and fetching agent versions and publishing (retell-docs-47), and Conductor lets users review proposed prompt/flow changes before applying them (retell-docs-53, retell-docs-54), covering the 'version' and 'review' parts of the story. However, no evidence documents an explicit rollback/revert-to-previous-version feature or a version diff/history UI. missing for 10: explicit rollback/revert-to-version capability, version comparison/diff view, independent confirmation of versioning workflow in practice.
